message.content: In one of the conversations, Wolfgang mentions finding a game soundtrack that he loves and wants to share with LiHua. Specifically, Wolfgang expresses his appreciation for the music from the game "Final Fantasy" series, noting that the music is "legendary" and "iconic." He also highlights the music from "Journey," describing it as "so atmospheric and beautiful," and suggests that LiHua should check it out along with other soundtracks. Therefore, Wolfgang finds a cool game soundtrack named "Final Fantasy" and intends to share it with LiHua.
